paths.path_title: Laravel + Vue Full-Stack Developer — REST API and SPA
paths.learner_scope: Entry/junior developers, progressing from general computer literacy to recurring tasks expected unaided during the first six months. No prior PHP or Vue/Laravel knowledge is assumed: PHP and pairing-specific JavaScript and framework fundamentals are covered at working depth. General software-engineering practice is delegated to the Software Engineer path; SQL, relational modelling, Git, Linux, HTTP, testing, HTML/CSS and equivalent JavaScript foundations must be resolved as explicit prerequisites against this run's immutable global registry snapshot through the registry delta, not treated as unexplained assumed knowledge or duplicated. Where no equivalent registered foundation exists, include only the minimum required native coverage inside the existing benchmark families and count ceiling. Binding scope budget: target 135 final atomic concepts, hard ceiling 150; Stage 03 candidates must already fit, allowing for later atomicity splitting. Use approximately eight concepts per benchmark family, never more than twelve, and no additional capability families. Cut optional breadth rather than combine independently assessable skills or hide count by weakening atomicity. Scope conflict explicitly flagged: the run context and generator request BOTH REST/Sanctum and Inertia, but the supplied benchmark explicitly excludes Inertia as a primary approach, and the binding operator budget excludes all benchmark adjacent-scope areas. This specification therefore narrows its title and claim to the decoupled REST/SPA model; it does not certify the originally requested dual-model outcome. Restoring that outcome requires explicit upstream scope reconciliation and approved Inertia source coverage, not silent downstream repair. Full Blade templating, Livewire, primary Inertia development, deep standalone Laravel/Vue coverage, other framework pairings, native mobile, advanced DevOps and optional package trivia are excluded for the benchmark and budget reasons. Exercises must use supplied material; any supplied scaffolding must be recorded as scaffolding in the semantic dependency report, never mapped to an invented prerequisite concept.
